verdict.rationale: The Homebrew/brew GitHub README states that the code is under the BSD 2-clause license, which is an OSI open-source license. The source repository is public on GitHub, and other evidence shows users running audits against it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the license terms beyond the first-party README.
